column1: After upgrading SLF4J API from 1.7.36 to 2.0.3
the existing Logback 1.2.11 binding is ignored because
it uses the older SLF4J 1.7 binding mechanism.
SLF4J 2.0.3 cannot find a compatible logging provider
and therefore falls back to NOPLogger.
attempts to cast the returned NOPLogger to that type
which causes java.lang.ClassCastException and test errors.
